sum_arr = [0] * 11

mod1 = 998244353
mod2 = 10**9 + 7

cnt = 0
tmp = 0
ans = 0

def m1(x):
    return (x % mod1 + mod1) % mod1

def dfs1(x, v):
    global cnt
    if v > n:
        return
    if x > 6:
        return
    cnt += 1
    ve[x].append(m1(cnt - v))
    sum_arr[x] += m1(cnt - v)
    for i in range(10):
        dfs1(x + 1, v * 10 + i)

def dfs2(x, v):
    global cnt, ans
    if v > n:
        return
    if x >= 1:
        if v * n * 10 > n and v * n + n - 1 <= n:
            for i in range(7):
                t = 1
                val = m1(cnt - v * t)
                from bisect import bisect_left
                pos = bisect_left(ve[i], mod1 - val)
                ans += val * len(ve[i]) + sum_arr[i] - mod1 * (len(ve[i]) - pos)
                ans %= mod2
            cnt += tmp
            return
        cnt += 1
        ans += m1(cnt - v)
        ans %= mod2
    start = 1 if x == 0 else 0
    for i in range(start, 10):
        dfs2(x + 1, v * 10 + i)
